items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: The guy used to be with Jimmy Gunn.

ctx.x: He kind of hoity so, but he broke his own. And well the people know the Budweiser back and at least they want to sue the Budweiser people. So they backed out. See they had to go back to the front and they pulled out the interciser out of there. And after they played there about a few years, I can show you some words that a fella, we call him Mestedi. I don't know if you know him, he loved dances. A fella, he even reminded me of Mestedi. He used to come and that man would stand inside the band stand and he'd clap…
The guy used to be with Jimmy Gunn.
Yeah, he lived down in North Roche Blade Street, 1911.
